newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields end higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields end higher in quiet trade.

text.p: 1515 GMT - Swedish bond yields ended higher on Monday in quiet trade ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on Tuesday and the crown weakened slightly.
Bond yields and the crown opened stronger, but soon softened.
Market players do not expect the Riksbank to cut its repo rate from the current level of 4.10 percent at its regular Tuesday tender as the crown is seen as too soft.
* Six-month T-bill rate rises five basis points to 4.27 pct.
* Ten-year bond yield climbs five basis points to 7.42 pct.
* Crown softens to 4.5220 to mark vs 4.5190 late on Friday.
